01 / THE WORDS I LOVE

Persian literature
& heritage.

I have a deep love for Persian literature, poetry, and the rich tradition of Persian mystical literature. I’m particularly fascinated by the philosophical reflections of Omar Khayyam, the epic world of the Shahnameh, and the intellectual and spiritual heritage of classical Iran.
